claims.summary: Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 4B now have one current-compiler, exact-provenance, same-brief UX comparison. Both real browser runs produced valid 12-lesson 99/A packages with zero P0/P1/P2, 101 extracted files, and zero cost.

The exact pair proves that equal package grades can conceal unequal repair work: Qwen uses 85 Scion calls versus Gemma's 52, a 1.64x amplification that fails the 1.25x promotion ceiling. The burden audit can reproduce this result directly from committed evidence files.

The local shim preloads exact weights, reports worker loading and readiness separately from HTTP availability, records load duration and failures, retries failed preloads, and makes concurrent first requests await one shared ready promise.
